canonical_project: China Mobile (Gansu Qingyang) Data Center N01 / New Industrialization Green Intelligent Computing Center
owner: China Mobile Group Gansu Co., Ltd.
notes: People's Daily identified the China Mobile new industrialization green intelligent computing center inside Qingyang EDWC park as operational. Science and Technology Daily described China Mobile (Gansu Qingyang) Data Center N01 as Gansu's first 18 kW intelligent-computing high-power data center and part of a domestic 10,000-card compute cluster.
